name: Eversend Money Transfer & Payments API
description: Eversend is a money transfer and payments API that enables businesses to manage multi-currency wallets, send payouts via mobile money and bank transfers, collect payments, exchange currencies, manage beneficiaries, handle crypto transactions, and issue virtual cards. It covers Africa and global markets with support for multiple payment rails.
